Package neqsim.process.engineering

Class LineDesignInput

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.LineDesignInput
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class LineDesignInput extends Object implements Serializable
Project line-list data used to complement simulation geometry with mechanical-design inputs.

Hydraulic dimensions remain on the associated PipeLineInterface. This class records the information normally supplied by a controlled line list: nominal dimensions, material, corrosion allowance, design conditions, insulation and layout allowances. Calculated results remain review-required until checked against the project piping class, stress analysis and fabrication specification.
